title: Netherite in furnace
description: Do you need netherite urgently? Don't worry! This datapack adds the ability to craft netherite armor and tools in the furnace!
body:
**___________________________________**

![ㅤ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/552d495915b66e0d94060e462539c00c6bbe5a52.png)
![ㅤ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df2a68172517755ff97017c336364d8e86e85a88.png)

**Hi,have you ever wanted to smelt netherite items in a furnace?** This datapack will allow you to do so. All you need to do is place any netherite tool or armor in the _furnace_ and **_wait_**.

![Example ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90df63c177e45c32e90a1ca5a78aa2e0f989a2cb.png)

This is an additional feature of the datapack - the ability to smelt netherite

![ㅤ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/731ab9c527a127f151280d5a8a56f43044e73788.png)

**_You can also use this datapack to smelt a netherite block into a diamond block, but you'll have to wait._**

**![Netherite to diamond ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/656b994d22ad7c0ebf6d4241f1246909bf15046a.png)**
**___________________________________**
